title: 3 Day Mount Meru Trek | Scenic Hiking Adventure in Arusha Tanzania
description: 3 Day Mount Meru Trek, a rewarding adventure to Tanzania’s second-highest peak and one of the country’s most scenic mountain experiences. Ideal for adventurers with limited time, this moderate trek combines dramatic landscapes, rich wildlife encounters, and unforgettable summit views.

The route passes through lush montane forest, bamboo groves, and open moorland, offering chances to spot colobus monkeys, bushbucks, giraffes, and diverse birdlife within Arusha National Park. The climb culminates in a sunrise summit at 4,562 meters, where sweeping views of Mount Kilimanjaro, the Great Rift Valley, and the surrounding plains provide a spectacular reward. With comfortable hut accommodations and expert guidance, Mount Meru is both an excellent standalone trek and ideal preparation for Kilimanjaro.
highlights: Spectacular sunrise views of Mount Kilimanjaro
Unique trek through Arusha National Park with wildlife sightings
Scenic landscapes: rainforest, bamboo, moorland, and volcanic ridges
Ideal warm-up climb for Mount Kilimanjaro
Perfect for trekkers with limited time

itinerary.title: Arusha – Momella Gate – Miriakamba Hut
itinerary.text: Begin your adventure with an early morning drive from Arusha to Momella Gate, the entrance to Arusha National Park. After registration, start trekking through lush tropical rainforest, where towering trees, moss-covered trunks, and vibrant ferns create a dense green canopy. Along the trail, you may spot colobus monkeys, bushbucks, giraffes, and colorful bird species while enjoying the sounds of flowing streams and waterfalls. The gentle ascent leads to Miriakamba Hut, nestled within the forest, where you can relax, enjoy a warm meal, and prepare for the days ahead.

itinerary.title: Miriakamba Hut – Saddle Hut
itinerary.text: After breakfast, ascend through higher montane forest and bamboo zones, gradually transitioning into open moorland and volcanic terrain. The trail offers spectacular views of the crater, surrounding valleys, and wildlife roaming below. Pause for lunch among giant lobelias and groundsels before continuing to Saddle Hut, located between the main summit and Little Meru. Spend the afternoon resting and acclimatizing, exploring the volcanic surroundings, and enjoying a breathtaking sunset over Mount Kilimanjaro and the plains below.

itinerary.title: Summit – Descent to Arusha
itinerary.text: Begin the summit attempt around midnight, climbing steadily along rocky ridges under a star-filled sky. Reach Mount Meru Summit (4,562 m) at sunrise, where you are rewarded with panoramic views of Mount Kilimanjaro, the Great Rift Valley, and the expansive Arusha plains—an unforgettable moment of triumph. After celebrating at the summit, descend carefully back to Saddle Hut and continue down to Miriakamba Hut for a well-earned breakfast. Complete the descent through forest trails to Momella Gate, where a transfer returns you to Arusha, marking the end of an exhilarating and scenic mountain adventure.

summary: 3 Day Mount Meru Trek, a rewarding adventure to Tanzania’s second-highest peak and one of the country’s most scenic mountain experiences.
